title: Team lineup writes replace the lineups in one findByIdAndUpdate
decision: `ITeamRepository.updateLineups(teamId, lineups)` maps each slot, uses `findByIdAndUpdate(teamId, { lineups }, { new: true })`, throws `NotFoundError` if the team is absent, and returns `toTeam(doc).lineups`. `removePlayerFromLineups` matches by `playerId` rather than `_id`.
consequences: Mocked repository tests do not exercise real Mongoose subdocument behavior; explicit mappers avoid depending on Mongoose defaults, and manual verification covers the persistence round-trip.
